# Technical clean baseline

This fixture carries the normative near-misses for the kept technical rules.
Each pattern below must survive a sweep without a single flag.

A detached (s) is ordinary punctuation, and a spaced key (s) is prose. The
word port(s)able is an ordinary token, and `function(s)` in inline code is
excluded from the surface entirely.

Use 10 PM or 10:45 AM with a space. The tokens item10pm and 10pmx read as
identifiers. A 24-hour value like 16:00 needs no marker, and 6p.m.foo keeps
its trailing letters.
